producer_report.summary: I rewrote the '### A1 measurements' entry in docs/decisions.md, but it holds no measurements. This job's shell refuses `sccache`, `du`, `df` and `git worktree`, so every field gives the command I tried and the exact refusal text. T and S appear only as the design's estimates, labeled as such (about 6 GB and about 0.2 GB, design lines 103-104). The D84 cause is stated as not found, with what I tried. I also reworded the CHANGELOG entry to lead with the D145 acceptance and to say the A1 entry is not a measurement. The D145 acceptance in decisions.md and in the async-drain.md status line is kept from the prior candidate. `cargo test -p xtask --test policy` passed (12 tests). I made two small wording edits to line references after that run. fmt, clippy and the full test run are left to Athena's checks.
